name: Aboard
description:
Aboard: HR & People Management for Claude

Aboard is Teamtailor's HR and people management platform. This connector gives Claude secure access to your organization's employee data and everyday people workflows, so you can handle HR tasks without leaving the conversation.

People & Org Structure
Look up colleagues, job titles, departments, and office locations. Get a full team overview to understand reporting lines and org structure at a glance.

Meetings & 1:1s
Schedule, update, and manage meetings and 1:1s with colleagues. Build reusable agenda templates to keep recurring check-ins, syncs, and performance conversations structured and consistent.

Tasks & Onboarding
Create, assign, list, and complete tasks. Perfect for onboarding checklists, offboarding flows, and everyday to-dos across the team.

Time Off & Absence
Request time off, browse available time off types, track absences across the team, and check company holidays before planning meetings or deadlines.

Performance & Skills
Explore review projects and collected reviews, browse skills and skill categories, and create or update skill ratings to support growth conversations and competence mapping.

Whether you're in HR, people ops, or leading a team, Aboard turns Claude into a hands-on assistant for employee onboarding, absence management, performance management, and daily people operations.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Aboard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Aboard to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.aboardhr.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Aboard MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Aboard lists 30 MCP tools, including complete_task, create_agenda_template, create_meeting, create_skill_rating, create_task, create_time_off_request, delete_skill_rating, get_agenda_template, get_colleague, get_meeting, get_review_project, and list_agenda_templates.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Aboard?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Aboard in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Aboard requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Aboard is developed by Teamtailor. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
